blocking.issue: This contradiction was missed in earlier rounds and is still present (L2-4 reports it too). The required NOSCRIPT scenario makes a second blocking State Store round trip for one Policy on one request: `EVALSHA`, then `EVAL` again. Foundation pack 8.7 rule 1 forbids that. Contributors who build the integration test from this line would fail a conforming implementation, which applies `failureMode` and reloads the script off the request path. The test would also pass an implementation that breaks the pack.
blocking.evidence: Integration tests: "- `EVALSHA`, the cached form of pack section 8.8's single GCRA `EVAL`, meets `NOSCRIPT` after a script cache flush and resends `EVAL` within the same deadline." Foundation pack 8.7 rule 1: "Before the response is committed, each Policy makes at most one blocking State Store round trip per request." docs/architecture/09-traffic-management-and-resilience.md: "Nodes `SCRIPT LOAD` every script at connect, reconnect and failover; `NOSCRIPT` applies `failureMode` and schedules a reload, so no request makes a second round trip (pack 8.7 rule 1)."
blocking.fix: Replace the bullet with: "- After a script cache flush, `EVALSHA` (the cached form of pack section 8.8's single GCRA `EVAL`) meets `NOSCRIPT`: that request applies the Policy's `failureMode` without a second round trip (pack section 8.7 rule 1), the Node reloads the script off the request path, and the next request's `EVALSHA` succeeds." This adds about 20 words, and the band has room: the body is 3,995 of 5,000 words.

blocking.issue: The paragraph says it asserts each target-dependent code "wherever raised". It then lists fewer places than the foundation pack requires, and test authors follow that list. First, RZ-CFG-033 is not asserted at Ruralz Control ingest, and "RZ-CFG-028 also at Ruralz Control ingest" implies that only RZ-CFG-028 is raised there. Pack 8.14 has Ruralz Control verify Plugin signatures at ingest, and every signature failure is RZ-CFG-033. Second, RZ-CFG-027 is limited to push and pull. Pack 8.1 also has the Control Stream and Last-Known-Good check the full digest, and any mismatch is RZ-CFG-027. L2-5 reports the same gap.
blocking.evidence: Conformance suites: "RZ-CFG-027 at `ruralz bundle push` or pull; RZ-CFG-028 and RZ-CFG-033 in `ruralz bundle build`, `validate --online` and Node activation, RZ-CFG-028 also at Ruralz Control ingest." Pack 8.14, Plugin artifact row: "Verified by ... `ruralz bundle build` and `validate --online`, Ruralz Control at ingest, Nodes at activation". Configuration model: "every signature failure is RZ-CFG-033". Pack 8.1: "The Control Stream, OCI pulls, Last-Known-Good and every verification carry and check the full `sha256:<64 hex>`; a mismatch is RZ-CFG-027".
blocking.fix: Rewrite the tail as: "RZ-CFG-027 at `ruralz bundle push`, OCI pull, Control Stream delivery and Last-Known-Good boot; RZ-CFG-028 and RZ-CFG-033 in `ruralz bundle build`, `validate --online`, Ruralz Control ingest and Node activation (pack sections 8.1 and 8.14)." While editing this paragraph, also replace "The five target-dependent codes" with "The five checks that can fail after a green offline run", which is the Configuration model's own wording.
